cases.requirement: M4-050 preserves the accepted M4-041 non-claim that a reached ToolRuntime hard guard does not prove complete mediation and does not govern direct Node filesystem access.
The measured actor is host-privileged in-process code using a direct host filesystem API outside Harness ToolRuntime rather than a Harness tool, Adapter filesystem port, shell or subprocess.
The measured target is an isolated test-owned disposable temporary path and the sentinel file is absent before the measured mutation.
The measured payload is fixed synthetic non-secret data; M4-050 does not require reading or modifying real credentials, user secrets or production files.
In a supported reference environment, the direct host filesystem mutation succeeds and the sentinel contains the exact expected bytes after the same measured operation.
The same measured direct-host mutation originates zero Harness ToolRuntime executions.
The same measured direct-host mutation invokes zero safe-runtime tools/pre-execute policy handlers as its mutation path.
The same measured direct-host mutation invokes zero safe-runtime monotonic tool guards as its mutation path.
M4-050 does not fabricate a Harness tool body execution or tools/result fact for the direct host mutation.
When DHFS-003 through DHFS-009 are proven coherently for one supported measured operation, the exact boundary classification is EXPECTED_UNGOVERNED.
EXPECTED_UNGOVERNED is a negative test/evidence classification and must not be relabeled as CapabilityDecision ALLOW, DENY, SANDBOXED, TOOL_ENFORCED, PROVIDER_ENFORCED or PROCESS_ISOLATED.
A successful direct host write must not be retroactively represented as an authorized CapabilityRequest, CapabilityDecision, Receipt, Lease consumption or approval event.
If an external OS, container, read-only-filesystem or CI restriction prevents establishment of a writable test-owned target, the result is ENVIRONMENT_UNSUPPORTED rather than safe-runtime DENIED.
An ENVIRONMENT_UNSUPPORTED-only matrix cannot accept M4-050; at least one exact-head supported environment must produce EXPECTED_UNGOVERNED.
Contradictory or incomplete evidence, pre-existing sentinel state, mismatched bytes or accidental ToolRuntime traversal is INVALID_EVIDENCE and fails conformance.
M4-050 production work must not intercept or monkey-patch node:fs, module loading, syscalls, process sandboxing or filesystem virtualization merely to change the expected negative result.
Absent a concrete existing false-claim or misclassification defect, M4-050 requires no speculative production rewrite; executable evidence and truthful boundary classification are sufficient.
The direct-host witness intentionally bypasses Adapter filesystem ports; using those ports would test provider mediation rather than the M4-050 negative boundary.
M4-050 does not claim equivalent shell spelling, subprocess redirection or child-process filesystem effects; those remain outside this Gate.
M4-050 proves that M4 tool controls alone cannot justify complete filesystem tool-enforced, provider-enforced or process-isolated coverage for direct host filesystem effects.

Repository evidence confirms no accepted M4 process-isolated plugin host forces arbitrary in-process code through safe-runtime filesystem mediation; M14 remains the planned stronger isolation milestone.
M4-045 audit egress does not fabricate an audit-safe source fact for an out-of-pipeline direct host filesystem mutation.
All assertions about Harness pre-execute, guard or ToolRuntime behavior use the exact pinned 0.1.0-rc.5 commit 47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a rather than default-branch behavior.

The protocol-first M4-050 delta contains no production TypeScript, executable source-conformance tests, dependency/lockfile changes, schema/protocol wire changes, workflow changes, HISTORY rewrite, roadmap acceptance marker, M4-051+ implementation or PR merge.
